description: Use when an agent must see a place from above or check vegetation, water or change. Input: lat, lon, radius_m (200-10000), mode (true_color, false_color, ndvi, ndwi, moisture), date, days back, max_cloud. Picks the clearest Sentinel-2 scene by cloud share inside your area, not the whole tile. Output: JSON PNG URL (+ other modes), scene date, area cloud %, alternatives. No scene: 404, not charged. Example: ?lat=37.5665&lon=126.978 Price: $0.009 USDC via x402.

date.description: Latest acceptable scene date YYYY-MM-DD (default today; 2017-01-01 or later)

days.description: Look-back window in days before date (default 30)

max_cloud.description: Target max cloud % inside the area (default 40); if no scene meets it the clearest is returned with fulfillment=best_available

mode.description: Rendering (default true_color); URLs for the other modes are returned too

radius_m.description: Half-width of the square area in meters (default 2000)

name: satellite_image
title: Satellite image of any place: clearest recent Sentinel-2 scene, true color or NDVI
